test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
How many pens are there?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c68eb3339a08b2fd62011a232850b7b4cfdd91cdeca0798e7be9e1423f5a525.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ffab913539393b28bbccf6163a55361eea842857a66f90037df7a7542f60b60.png] 

The shaded area shows "Total number of Pens".

Total Pens are: 12 + 4 + 9 = 25.

So, there are 25 pens.

Hence, the correct answer is "25".
